title: MOTION (HUTT - HERNANDEZ) relative to updating the List of Citywide Special Events.
text:
[Council File 26-1396]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - HERNANDEZ) relative to updating the List of Citywide Special Events.
Recommendation for Council action:
INSTRUCT the Chief Legislative Analyst to include the following changes / amounts in the List of Citywide Special Events for Council District 10:
DELETE MINC Music & Arts Festival - $75,000
ADD Mid City Music & Arts Festival - $75,000
summary: Council motion swapping the $75,000 citywide special event allocation for Council District 10 from the MINC Music & Arts Festival to the Mid City Music & Arts Festival.

details.action: update of list of citywide special events

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 13, 2026); Council action final
